purpose: capture CSIPHY kernel handler log output during one IR-illuminated CSI attempt
additional_observation: CSIPHY IRQ handler status log lines around the one-shot
capture_status: no PHY handler status lines because the pinned non-debug CSIPHY path leaves its IRQ disabled; no sensor frames or CSID3 packets; cleanup clean; phone returned to installed kernel #29
limitations: The CSIPHY IRQ is requested then disabled at probe; its only enable_irq call is excluded by DBG_CSIPHY=0, so handler logs are unavailable in this build.
The raw PHY status snapshot values have no verified MSM8994 CSIPHY v3.1 bit decode.
Enabling the IRQ for future diagnostic logging would let the handler clear status registers and would change the current passive observation behavior.
The profile file remains private and was copied only to the phone's temporary data directory.
